function.name: stock_ticker
function.description: Retrieves the latest stock ticker information for a specified company. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company_name.description: The name of the company for which the stock ticker information should be retrieved.

ticker_symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the company's stock. This field is optional.

exchange.description: The name of the exchange on which the company's stock is listed. This field is optional. Default: 'AAPL'
